title: Donor-held-out expression-only cortical-layer transfer
current_best_explanation: No current global winner has been verified on this exact frozen input, split and scorer. A published dataset name or broad leaderboard lead is insufficient.
executed_endpoint: HumanPilot DLPFC Visium: two donors/eight sections train, one donor/four sections test; 33086 × 500 training expression features selected using outer-training variance, 14243 test spots. Seven anatomical layer/white-matter labels. Equal-section macro-F1; no coordinates, histology, external reference or gene-token interface supplied.

existing_reference.name: SingleR Python 0.5.0, train-donor×label mean profiles, fixed classic marker/fine-tuning settings
existing_reference.evidence: A: exact frozen supervised slice, scorer and same expression features.
existing_reference.strength: A genuine reference-transfer specialist and strong local comparator; retain its measured advantage wherever present.
problems: Only two training donors and one held-out donor.
Curated labels used histology and expression, so labels are not wholly orthogonal.
existing_reference.verification_scope: Only the named locally audited reference/archived outputs, not every newer candidate or equal-budget/global optimality.

candidates.name: SingleR 0.5.0 frozen reference; later release/tuning separate
candidates.evidence: B/A: maintained specialist family; frozen 0.5.0 is already executed.
candidates.information_match: The 0.5.0 configuration is already measured. Current 0.5.1 or new tuning is unexecuted and would require a separate prospective record.

candidates.name: scGPT / Nicheformer expression representations
candidates.evidence: B: relevant current transfer methods with conditional benchmark performance.
candidates.information_match: Require gene identities/tokenization and appropriate Visium preprocessing; anonymous 500-column vectors cannot silently gain those identities. Nicheformer need not require coordinates at inference, but its cell-level task differs.

candidates.name: Novae / GraphST / spatial domain models
candidates.evidence: B: relevant spatial-domain contenders on different information.
candidates.information_match: Coordinates/neighborhoods and often within-section clustering/label matching are unavailable here; ARI cannot become supervised F1.

candidates.name: VINTER
candidates.information_match: Image/gene interface and held-out-pair tuning violate the frozen expression-only unseen-donor information boundary.

candidates.name: Training-only expression classifier / scalable tabular representation
candidates.evidence: C: feasible numerical challenger, not a published layer winner.
candidates.information_match: Compatible only with the supplied columns and training donors; no test-batch adaptation.

recommended_next_comparator: Keep SingleR; prospectively compare train-donor-selected linear/kernel or scalable tabular methods on the same features. Create a separate gene-identified track before testing scGPT/Nicheformer.
switching_assessment: RETAIN SingleR as the strongest defensible already matched specialist; ADD challengers separately, Tier B. Do not replace it with a spatial leaderboard or multimodal VLM result. A current global best remains unresolved even when a local reference wins.
limitations: Four held-out sections share one donor.
Spatial smoothing inferred from test row order is prohibited.
Gene identities/coordinates/images are additional information if added later; provide equally to all arms in a new contract.
Current SingleR documentation is 0.5.1; frozen 0.5.0 must not be silently upgraded.
No published cortical-layer ARI or matched-cluster accuracy is imported.

evidence_tiers.A: Locally executed and audited on this frozen protocol; establishes a comparator result, not universal optimality.
evidence_tiers.B: Primary method/benchmark with relevant task evidence but an unmatched split, inputs, scorer or budget.
evidence_tiers.C: Author repository, preprint, mathematical proposal or adaptation requiring additional validation.
evidence_tiers.D: Unresolved access, unavailable artifacts or input mismatch precludes an executable recommendation.

execution_policy: Literature review only. No inference, fitting, new scores, checkpoint downloads, frozen protocol edits or result changes. Any new comparator requires a prospective amendment, frozen training-only selection and separate result records.
score_import_policy: No unmatched published numbers were imported into benchmark scores.
